final: WITH invoice_counts AS (SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) as invoice_count FROM Invoices GROUP BY order_id), shares AS (SELECT order_id, invoice_count, CAST(invoice_count AS FLOAT) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Invoices) as share FROM invoice_counts), avg_share_cte AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM shares), above_avg AS (SELECT shares.order_id, shares.invoice_count, shares.share FROM shares, avg_share_cte WHERE shares.share > avg_share_cte.avg_share) SELECT SUM(invoice_count) as total_invoices, AVG(share) as average_share, AVG(share - (SELECT avg_share FROM avg_share_cte)) as average_excess FROM above_avg
